Using random forest models, we projected current and future abundances of the most common reef fish and estimated community‐weighted mean traits under mid‐ and long‐term climate scenarios. Our findings indicate a shift toward fish communities dominated by species with shorter lifespans, smaller maximum sizes and earlier maturity, along with increased growth rates and fecundity. Long‐term scenarios suggest functional homogenization, with reduced trait diversity due to environmental filtering, potentially leading to communities with higher functional redundancy. This study provides initial insights into how climate‐driven changes could reshape functional patterns in northeastern Mediterranean reef fish communities, with significant implications for ecosystem services and resilience. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用随机森林模型预测东北地中海浅海礁鱼群落在中长期气候情景下的物种丰度及功能性状变化。结果显示，未来气候变化将导致群落偏向短寿命、小体型、早熟鱼类占优，同时生长率和繁殖力增加。长期情景下，环境过滤作用可能引发功能同质化，降低性状多样性并提高功能冗余度。该研究首次揭示气候驱动下该区域鱼类功能格局的重塑趋势，对生态系统服务与恢复力具有重要影响。

papers.title: Microplastic Contamination in Aquatic Biota: a Comparative Study of Fish Species from the Ganga and Gomti Rivers
papers.authors: Kumar, Priyanshu; Raw, Kamla Pat; Shukla, Vertika; Singh, Ritu; Mishra, Sunita; Sharma, Monica; Yadav, Subhash Kumar; Kumar, Narendra
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较分析了恒河与戈姆蒂河鱼类体内的微塑料污染状况，旨在评估不同河流生态系统中微塑料对水生生物的影响。通过检测多种鱼类的微塑料摄入量，揭示物种间及河流间的污染差异。结果显示，两河鱼类均普遍检出微塑料，但恒河样本的丰度显著高于戈姆蒂河，且食性及栖息层影响摄入模式。研究为淡水鱼类微塑料风险评估及河流管理提供了基础数据。

papers.title: Microbial drivers of high aquaculture productivity: decoupling of taxonomic and functional profiles enables efficient nitrogen cycling in greenhouse shrimp farming
papers.authors: Shen, Hongye; Ma, Liangxiao; Li, Jinshan; Hu, Yongmei; Peng, Nan; Zhao, Shumiao
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦于温室养虾系统中微生物驱动的高水产生产力机制，旨在解析分类与功能谱系解耦对氮循环效率的影响。通过对比分析微生物群落结构与功能基因表达，发现功能冗余和代谢路径优化显著提升了氮去除能力，从而支撑高密度养殖下的水质稳定。研究结果为可持续水产养殖的微生物管理提供了新见解。

papers.title: The evolutionary history and morphological divergence of corallivorous fishes on coral reefs
papers.authors: Marrable, I; Peoples, N; Kolmann, M A; Huie, J M; Figueira, W F
papers.abstract: Abstract Specialised ecological niches can represent evolutionary traps that increase extinction risk when environments change. The consumption of coral tissue, mucus and skeleton is a rare feeding niche despite the abundance of coral on reefs, which raises questions about the evolutionary consequences of this dietary specialisation. In this study, we used phylogenetic comparative methods, micro-CT scanning, and scanning electron microscopy to explore the evolutionary history of corallivory across reef fishes and compare feeding morphology across species within a major clade of corallivorous species (Chaetodontidae) that vary in their coral consumption. We show that obligate corallivory has evolved independently at least 17 times but is an evolutionary “dead end” for most reef fish species. Early origination of facultative corallivory may have contributed to the success of butterflyfishes, the predominant clade of coral-feeding fishes, as they diversified in competitive reef environments. Obligate and facultative butterflyfish species differ primarily in dental morphology while overall cranial traits are largely similar between groups. Coral feeding requires continuous foraging with narrow energetic margins, and climate-driven disturbances occur markedly faster than evolutionary transitions away from corallivory. This temporal mismatch between change at ecological and evolutionary timescales subjects corallivorous fishes to heightened vulnerability as climate-driven disturbances increase in frequency and severity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用系统发育比较方法、micro-CT扫描和扫描电镜技术，探究珊瑚礁鱼类食珊瑚习性的进化历史及形态分化。结果显示，专性食珊瑚在礁鱼类中至少独立演化17次，但多数物种此习性为进化“死胡同”；兼性食珊瑚的早期起源可能促进蝴蝶鱼科（Chaetodontidae）在竞争性礁环境中的多样化。专性与兼性蝴蝶鱼主要差异在牙齿形态，而颅骨特征总体相似。由于珊瑚摄食能量边际窄，且气候驱动的干扰远快于食性转变的进化速率，食珊瑚鱼类面临日益加剧的气候变化威胁，脆弱性显著升高。

papers.title: Navigating uncertainty and competing objectives: Spring chinook salmon recovery in the upper Willamette river
papers.authors: Couch, Claire E.; Wallick, J. Rose; Peterson, James T.; Morgan, Bailey A.; Keefer, Matthew L.; Caudill, Christopher C.; O’Malley, Kathleen G.; Murphy, Christina A.; White, James S.; Kelley, Jake R.
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦于俄勒冈州Willamette河上游春季奇努克鲑（Chinook salmon）的种群恢复问题，旨在应对管理中的不确定性及多目标冲突。通过整合种群动态模型与决策分析框架，评估不同恢复策略在生物、经济及社会目标间的权衡。研究为渔业管理者提供了在不确定条件下优化恢复路径的定量工具，强调适应性管理在濒危鲑鱼保护中的关键作用。
papers.keywords_matched: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries

papers.title: From Aquaculture to Acinetobacter: Growing the Phage Toolbox
papers.authors: Clokie, Martha; Sicheritz-Pontén, Thomas
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦水产养殖中致病性不动杆菌（Acinetobacter）的噬菌体疗法，旨在扩充针对该病原体的噬菌体工具库。通过分离和表征新型噬菌体，评估其裂解谱及作为生物防控剂的潜力，为水产养殖细菌病防控提供替代抗生素的策略。研究结果有望推动噬菌体疗法在水产健康管理中的实际应用。

papers.title: Innovation activity and export performance: Evidence from the European aquaculture sector
papers.authors: Madsen, Stine Hach Juul; Straume, Hans-Martin; Winter, Hanna; Hansen, Teis; Nielsen, Rasmus; Tsouri, Maria
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于欧洲水产养殖部门数据，探讨创新活动与出口绩效之间的关系。采用实证分析方法，揭示创新投入对出口竞争力的影响机制。研究发现，创新活动显著提升水产养殖企业的出口表现，且不同创新类型（如产品、工艺创新）的作用存在差异。该结论为水产养殖业制定创新驱动型出口战略提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal variation of fish assemblages in giant kelp forests Macrocystis pyrifera in the Tierra del Fuego Archipelago, southern Patagonia
papers.authors: Hüne, Mathias; Palacios, Mauricio; Davis, Ernesto
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了南巴塔哥尼亚火地岛群岛巨藻林（Macrocystis pyrifera）中鱼类群落结构的时空变化。通过采样分析不同季节和空间尺度的鱼类组成，揭示了巨藻林栖息地对鱼类多样性和丰度的关键影响。研究发现鱼类群落呈现显著的空间异质性和季节性动态，可能与藻林结构及环境因子相关。该结果为亚南极海域巨藻林生态系统的保护与管理提供了基础数据。

papers.title: Socio-economic Profile, Market Structure, and Marketing Constraints of Fish Vendors in Barnala District, Punjab, India
papers.authors: Kaur, Rajinder; Tanwar, P. S.
papers.abstract: The present study was conducted to assess the socio-economic conditions of fish vendors, the market structure, and the constraints faced in fish marketing in Barnala district, Punjab. The study was conducted from March to June 2026. Primary data were collected from 14 fish vendors through a structured questionnaire administered in Punjabi at three vending sites: Handiaya village (site 1), the fish market near Sekha Phatak (site 2), and the area near the Trident factory (site 3). The data were analysed using descriptive statistics, including frequencies and percentages. The results showed that 64.28% of the vendors were engaged solely in selling raw fish, whereas 35.72% combined fish vending with fish farming in village ponds. Although fish is highly perishable, 85.71% of the vendors did not have access to a deep freezer. None of the vendors was involved in fish processing or value addition, indicating potential scope for these activities in Barnala district. The major constraints included the lack of deep-freezer facilities, the use of handmade wooden descaling tools fitted with iron nails, and limited value addition.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了印度旁遮普邦Barnala区鱼类销售商的社会经济状况、市场结构及营销制约因素，数据来自2026年3月至6月对14位销售商的问卷调查。结果显示，64.28%的销售商仅从事生鱼销售，35.72%兼营鱼塘养殖；85.71%缺乏深冻设备，且无人涉及加工或增值活动。主要制约包括冷藏设施不足、手工去鳞工具简陋及增值有限，表明该地区在鱼类加工和增值方面存在发展潜力。

papers.title: What Do New Zealanders Think About Freshwater Fish? Results From a National Survey
papers.authors: Tadaki, Marc; McCarthy, Alaric; Weiss, Fabio; Rayne, Aisling; Crowley, Sarah; Farr, Alexis; Gibbs, Leah; Kitson, Jane; Reo, Nick; Stahlmann‐Brown, Philip
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: The 2025 Environmental Perceptions Survey provides unique insight into a nationally representative sample ( n = 1024) of New Zealanders’ perceptions of freshwater fish. About 8% of the sample had fished in the past 12 months and 30% had fished ever, and fisher subsamples were more male, more Māori and younger than the New Zealand population. Perceived awareness of local freshwater fish presence was higher for fishers than non‐fishers for all species, but both shared highest awareness of eel/tuna, whitebait and trout, which are also the most commonly fished species. Assessment of national fishing popularity and fishing pressure was mixed, but regional trends are evident. Respondents agreed that there are not enough freshwater fish, that fishers should be able to eat what they catch and that fish are healthy enough to eat. Respondents prefer more of all freshwater fish species rather than only one or two species. This data can help understand how people's relationships with freshwater and fish are changing and possibilities for building alliances for freshwater stewardship.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2025年环境感知调查，对1024名新西兰人的淡水鱼认知进行了全国代表性分析。约8%受访者在过去12个月内曾垂钓，30%曾有过垂钓经历，垂钓者群体更偏向男性、毛利裔及年轻人群。垂钓者对当地淡水鱼存在的感知度普遍高于非垂钓者，但两者对鳗鱼、银鱼和鳟鱼（最常见的捕捞物种）的认知度最高。受访者普遍认为淡水鱼数量不足、垂钓者应可食用渔获且鱼类健康可食，并倾向于支持多种淡水鱼类的存在而非单一物种。该数据有助于理解公众与淡水及鱼类关系的变化，并为淡水管理联盟的构建提供参考。

papers.title: Comprehensive Assessment of Fish Diversity Based on Surface Water and Sediment eDNA—A Case from Sansha Bay, Southeastern China
papers.authors: Zhang, Zhi; Zhang, Yuting; Shen, Zhongyuan; Wang, Feipeng; Mu, Jingli
papers.abstract: Shansha Bay, southeastern China, is a typical semi-enclosed bay facing intense anthropogenic pressure, with mariculture production reaching approximately 660,000 tons annually, predominantly driven by the large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea) industry. To assess how these pressures influence biodiversity detection, we employed eDNA metabarcoding targeting the 12S rRNA gene to survey fish diversity across 10 sites, integrating both surface water and sediment matrices. A total of 40 species belonging to 16 orders, 27 families and 32 genera, were identified. Among them, L. crocea, Bostrychus sinensis, Clupanodon thrissa and Siganus fuscescens are the dominate species, which comprised over half of all OTUs. Comparison with historical trawl surveys revealed 30 newly recorded species, including the Japanese eel (Anguilla japonica) and oarfish (Regalecus glesne). Alpha diversity was low (Shannon: 0.69–1.93), with significant spatial disparities driven by freshwater runoff and hydrodynamics. While eDNA effectively captured the dominance of cultured species like L. crocea, the extreme biomass signal poses challenges for detecting wild populations. Our findings underscore that a multi-matrix eDNA approach is crucial for accurate biodiversity assessments in aquaculture-dominated coastal ecosystems, although distinguishing wild stocks from aquaculture-derived DNA remains a critical methodological hurdle.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于福建三沙湾10个站点的表层水和沉积物eDNA宏条形码（12S rRNA），系统评估了高密度养殖压力下的鱼类多样性，共鉴定40种鱼类（16目27科32属），其中大黄鱼、中华乌塘鳢、花鲚和褐篮子鱼为优势种。与历史拖网数据对比新增30个记录种（含日本鳗鲡和皇带鱼），但α多样性较低（Shannon指数0.69–1.93），且受淡水输入和水动力显著影响。研究表明，多介质eDNA方法对养殖主导的沿海生态系统多样性评估至关重要，但养殖物种（如大黄鱼）的极端生物量信号仍干扰野生种群检测，区分养殖源与野生源DNA是当前关键方法学挑战。

papers.title: Acute Toxic Impact of Cyclophosphamide on the Metabolic Organs of Siamese Fighting Fish (Betta splendens)
papers.authors: Sreebun, Somkiat; Prukudom, Sukumal; Siripattarapravat, Kannika; Srisampan, Supreeya; Saengtienchai, Aksorn; Eiamcharoen, Piyaporn; Poungcharean, Santi; Phanpoe, Chonphoom; Suksao, Onanong; Jermnak, Usuma
papers.abstract: Currently, emerging pharmaceutical contaminants (EPCs) pose a significant risk to aquatic biodiversity on both a global and regional scale. Their accumulation in the environment presents several challenges to both human health and ecological integrity. Among EPCs, cyclophosphamide (COP), a widely used alkylating cytotoxic and immunosuppressive drug in human and veterinary oncology, has become one of the most frequently detected environmental contaminants. It has been reported to impair the immune system, induce oxidative stress, and exhibit genotoxic and cytotoxic effects in various fish species. However, limited research has evaluated its toxicity in the Siamese fighting fish (Betta splendens), an endemic significant aquatic species in Thailand. This study evaluated the acute toxicity of COP in Betta splendens by assessing systemic oxidative stress responses, alterations in gene expression, and localized histopathological changes within both hepatic and renal tissues. The 96 h of median lethal concentration (LC50) value for COP in Betta splendens was determined to be 793.4 mg/L. High-concentration exposure (800 mg/L) induced severe systemic oxidative stress, evidenced by a significant reduction in superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity and a marked elevation in malondialdehyde (MDA) levels across both liver and kidney. At the transcriptomic level, acute COP exposure significantly upregulated pro-inflammatory (interleukin-1β, IL-1β and tumor necrosis factor, TNF-α), cellular stress (heat shock protein 70, HSP70), and apoptotic (caspase-3, Casp3) genes. Semi-quantitative histopathological evaluation revealed severe concentration-dependent structural damage. Hepatic lesions peaked at 800 mg/L characterized by diffuse vacuolation, vascular congestion, and extensive necrosis. Similarly, severe renal damage occurred at 800 mg/L, featuring marked vascular congestion, melanomacrophage aggregation, and widespread tubular necrosis. Overall, these findings demonstrate that acute waterborne COP exposure induces severe hepatotoxicity and nephrotoxicity in Betta splendens driven by oxidative stress, pro-inflammatory signaling, and apoptotic pathways. This study provides essential baseline toxicity thresholds and highlights the physiological risks COP spills pose to tropical freshwater labyrinth fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了抗癌药物环磷酰胺（COP）对暹罗斗鱼（Betta splendens）的急性毒性效应，旨在评估其作为新兴水体污染物对该泰国特有鱼种的生态风险。通过96小时急性暴露实验，测得COP的半数致死浓度（LC50）为793.4 mg/L，并发现高浓度（800 mg/L）暴露显著诱导肝脏和肾脏的氧化应激，表现为超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性下降及丙二醛（MDA）水平升高。转录组分析显示，急性COP暴露上调了促炎因子（IL-1β、TNF-α）、细胞应激蛋白（HSP70）及凋亡基因（caspase-3）的表达，同时组织病理学检查揭示浓度依赖性的肝细胞空泡化、血管充血、坏死及肾小管损伤。研究表明，COP通过氧化应激、炎症信号和凋亡通路引发严重的肝毒性和肾毒性，为热带淡水鱼类的COP污染风险评估提供了基础毒性阈值。

papers.title: Influence of Physico-Chemical and Microbiological Water-Quality Variables on  Aquaculture Species: A Vaal River Case Study (Gauteng, South Africa)
papers.authors: Omalanga, Landry S.; Onyari, Ednah K.
papers.abstract: This review examines the influence of physico-chemical and microbiological water‑quality variables on freshwater aquaculture in the Vaal river (Gauteng, South Africa). Available literature was examined to characterise key water‑quality parameters, including total dissolved solids (TDS), electrical conductivity (EC), turbidity, nutrients, heavy metals, microplastics, dissolved oxygen (DO), pH and microbial indicators such as Escherichia coli. In particular, this study discusses the interactive effects and aquaculture response in the Vaal river, links microbial dynamics to aquaculture health outcomes, gives the mechanistic interpretation of physico-chemical-biological linkages. The results showed the high TDS concentration (~177 mg/L) in the main stream of the Vaal river system is a potential threat to the agricultural sector, as it could be impacting on crop and aquacultural production and indications on DO concentrations are usually relatively high (>60%). The concentrations of metals in the Vaal river are generally high, leading to frequent fish kills. Furthermore, the high TDS concentrations in the Vaal river evidently influence the turbidity of the water and the higher pH values (6.3-8.7) in the Vaal river can be ascribed to higher algal concentrations. The high concentrations in E. coli (240 counts/100 mL) and algal pigments (69 mg/L) constitute a high risk the aquaculture production in the Vaal river system. To address these challenges, the water quality problem must be evaluated and resolved by reconsidering new management strategies and implementing treatment technologies. The findings of this work will assist relevant authorities in choosing appropriate water quality monitoring parameters for aquaculture areas.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了南非Vaal河（Gauteng省）物理化学及微生物水质变量对淡水水产养殖的影响，涵盖TDS、EC、浊度、营养盐、重金属、微塑料、DO、pH及E. coli等关键参数。结果显示，主流水体TDS浓度约177 mg/L，对农业及养殖生产构成潜在威胁；DO通常较高（>60%），但金属浓度偏高导致频繁鱼类死亡事件。高TDS影响水体浊度，pH值（6.3-8.7）偏高与藻类增殖相关；E. coli（240 counts/100 mL）和藻类色素（69 mg/L）的高含量对养殖系统构成高风险。研究建议重新评估管理策略并实施处理技术，为相关机构选择养殖区水质监测指标提供科学依据。

papers.title: A total infectome framework for resolving complex disease etiology in aquaculture
papers.authors: Xu, Yichun; Liu, Hanlin; Wu, Weichen; Gu, Yuchao; Zhang, Naiyou; Zhang, Cancan; Zhou, Renjun; Zhang, Defeng; Weng, Shaoping; Shi, Mang
papers.abstract: Abstract Traditional pathogen isolation can establish disease causality but often fails in complex infections involving unknown or multiple microbial backgrounds, whereas metatranscriptomics comprehensively captures the total infectome without directly resolving the primary etiological agent. Here, using overwintering syndrome (OWS) in grass carp, a widespread but unresolved aquaculture disease in China, as a disease model, we developed an integrated strategy that links comparative total infectome analysis with targeted isolation, experimental infection, and post-challenge infectome validation. Multi-organ metatranscriptomic profiling of healthy and diseased grass carp identified 107 microorganisms spanning viruses, bacteria, and eukaryotic microbes. Comparative infectomics prioritized Flavobacterium psychrophilum through its consistent disease enrichment, lesion-site abundance, multi-organ dissemination, and recurrence across affected hosts. Infection with F. psychrophilum alone reproduced the clinical signs, tissue pathology, mortality patterns, and infectome signatures of natural OWS, establishing it as the primary etiological agent. Temperature-shift experiments further showed that disease progression is promoted by warming from low temperature conditions, explaining the seasonal emergence of OWS. This work resolves a major grass carp disease and provides a generalizable framework for converting unbiased pathogen discovery into causal inference in complex infectious disease systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出了一种整合感染组学框架，用于解析水产养殖中复杂疾病的病因，以中国广泛发生的草鱼越冬综合征（OWS）为模型。通过多器官宏转录组分析健康与患病草鱼，鉴定出107种微生物，并结合比较感染组学、靶向分离、实验感染及攻毒后验证，确定黄杆菌（Flavobacterium psychophilum）为原发性病原。该菌单独感染可重现自然OWS的临床症状、组织病理、死亡模式及感染组特征，且温度升高促进疾病进展，解释了其季节性暴发。该框架为复杂感染系统中从病原发现到因果推断提供了通用方法。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in aquaculture: human-centered innovation, ethical governance, and data foundations for sustainable blue growth
papers.authors: Cortes, Jaynos R.
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming aquaculture by enabling precision management, environmental monitoring, and sustainability-oriented decision support. This review advances the discourse by integrating human-centered AI, ethical governance, and sustainability frameworks into a cohesive analysis of digital transformation in aquaculture. Based on a structured synthesis of 220 peer-reviewed publications from multidisciplinary literature published between 2015 and 2025, the study employs a qualitative review methodology to identify emerging trends, challenges, and research directions in AI-enabled aquaculture systems. The analysis reveals three emergent research pillars: (1) human-centered and explainable AI (XAI) systems that enhance decision transparency and farmer engagement; (2) ethical and governance frameworks addressing data ownership, algorithmic bias, and accountability; and (3) technological applications and innovation pathways linking machine learning, computer vision, and Internet of Things (IoT) platforms to operational sustainability. Findings indicate that while AI-driven tools have improved biomass estimation, behavior tracking, disease detection, and feed optimization, adoption remains constrained by affordability, digital literacy, infrastructure limitations, and data interoperability barriers. Ethical concerns related to transparency, cybersecurity, privacy, and equitable access to data further underscore the need for adaptive governance mechanisms. Aligning these technological and ethical dimensions with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Blue Transformation agenda and the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) AI Principles highlights a pathway toward inclusive, responsible, and context-sensitive AI ecosystems in aquaculture. By bridging the technical and human dimensions of AI deployment, this synthesis proposes a conceptual framework for responsible digital aquaculture in which innovation is embedded within social, ethical, and policy-responsive systems. The review concludes that the long-term sustainability of AI in aquaculture will depend not only on technological advancement but also on the co-evolution of governance structures, human capacity, and environmental stewardship.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了人工智能（AI）在水产养殖中的整合应用，聚焦于以人为中心的创新、伦理治理及可持续发展框架。基于2015-2025年间220篇同行评审文献的定性分析，识别出三大研究支柱：可解释AI（XAI）提升决策透明度、伦理与治理框架应对数据所有权及算法偏见、以及机器学习与物联网（IoT）驱动的技术应用。尽管AI在生物量估算、行为追踪、疾病检测和饲料优化方面成效显著，但采用仍受限于成本、数字素养、基础设施及数据互操作性障碍。研究提出与FAO蓝色转型议程及OECD AI原则对齐的概念框架，强调长期可持续性需技术创新与治理结构、人力能力及环境管理的协同演进。

papers.title: Gut Microbiome of Aquatic Organisms: Role in Immunity Formation and Effects on Aquaculture Productivity
papers.authors: Khmelevtsova, Liudmila E.; Prazdnova, Evgeniya V.; Mazanko, Maria S.; Brislavsky, Yaroslav A.; Rudoy, Dmitry V.
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is central to global food security, but intensification of production has increased disease risk and environmental pressure. The gut microbiome of aquatic organisms is now recognized as a key mediator of host physiology, nutrition, immunity, and pathogen resistance, making it a promising alternative to antimicrobial-based disease control. This review summarizes current knowledge on the composition, assembly, and functional roles of the gut microbiome in fish and crustaceans of aquacultural importance. Major bacterial phyla include Proteobacteria, Firmicutes, Bacteroidetes, Fusobacteria, Actinobacteria, and Verrucomicrobia. Community structure is shaped by environment, diet, host age, genetics, stress, and stochastic processes, with differences between marine and freshwater systems. The microbiome contributes to immune defense through short-chain fatty acid production, Toll-like receptor signaling, cytokine regulation, mucosal immunoglobulin responses, antimicrobial peptide and bacteriocin production, and competitive exclusion of pathogens. It also supports productivity by improving nutrient assimilation, vitamin and enzyme synthesis, and feed conversion. Probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics are discussed as strategies for targeted microbiome modulation, although unstable colonization and the lack of standardized protocols remain major challenges. Overall, targeted microbiome manipulation offers a promising route toward sustainable, antimicrobial-reduced aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨了水产动物肠道微生物组在免疫形成中的作用及其对养殖生产力的影响。研究总结了鱼虾类肠道微生物的组成、组装机制及功能角色，主要菌门包括Proteobacteria、Firmicutes等，群落结构受环境、饮食、宿主年龄等因素调控。微生物通过短链脂肪酸产生、Toll-like receptor信号、抗菌肽合成等途径增强免疫防御，并通过改善营养吸收和饲料转化促进生产力。益生菌、prebiotics和synbiotics作为定向调控策略具有潜力，但定植不稳定和缺乏标准化方案仍是主要挑战，总体指向可持续、减抗的水产养殖路径。

papers.title: Adoption of Better Management Practices in Penaeus vannamei Aquaculture: A Critical Review with Special Reference to South India
papers.authors: Kunda, Sumanth Kumar; Pulupu, SrinivasaRao
papers.abstract: Better Management Practices (BMPs) have become a central instrument for disease prevention, resource efficiency, food-safety assurance and environmental improvement in Indian whiteleg shrimp aquaculture. This critical narrative review examines the technical content, adoption, determinants and reported outcomes of BMPs in Penaeus vannamei production, with particular attention to Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and the wider southern Indian coastline. Literature published from 2000 to 21 April 2026 was identified through accessible scholarly indexes, publisher records, citation searching and authoritative institutional sources, with earlier foundational studies retained where necessary. The evidence indicates that BMP adoption is substantial but uneven. Practices offering immediate and observable private returns, including feed control, seed screening and aeration management, generally face fewer adoption barriers than practices whose benefits depend on coordinated action, such as crop synchronisation, fallowing, shared water management and disease reporting. Indian disease-burden, efficiency and adoption studies demonstrate the scale of preventable loss and identify plausible management levers, but they do not isolate the causal effect of BMP adoption. Most adoption evidence remains cross-sectional, geographically concentrated and dependent on self-report. Objective residue testing and a randomised extension intervention from Vietnam provide stronger evidence that well-designed training can improve antimicrobial stewardship, although transferability to South India requires direct evaluation. The principal implementation constraints arise from unequal access to assets, trusted advice, collective organisation, traceability and risk finance. Future research should prioritise longitudinal, quasi-experimental and randomised evaluation; linkage of residue-testing, training and cluster records; and regionally representative studies outside Andhra Pradesh. BMP policy is most likely to be effective when information and finance support practices with private returns, while collective-benefit practices are reinforced through credible group governance and carefully designed market or insurance incentives.
papers.summary_cn: 本文系统回顾了印度南部凡纳滨对虾养殖中良好管理规范（BMPs）的技术内容、采用情况及其决定因素，重点关注安得拉邦、泰米尔纳德邦及南印度沿海地区。研究发现，BMPs采用率虽高但不均衡，饲料控制、苗种筛选和增氧管理等即时收益型实践更易推广，而作物同步、休塘和共享水管理等需协调行动的实践面临更多障碍。现有证据多为横断面自我报告，缺乏因果效应评估，越南的随机推广试验提示培训可改善抗菌药物管理，但需在南印度直接验证。未来研究应优先采用纵向、准实验和随机化设计，并加强残留检测、培训与集群数据的关联分析。

papers.title: Using historical fish collections to track microplastic contamination in Costa Rican freshwater ecosystems
papers.authors: Angulo, Arturo; Blanco-Rodríguez, Juliana; Carrillo-González, Lucía; Fallas-Murillo, Meivelyn; González-Martínez, Allison; Herrera-Berrios, Michelle; Oreamuno-Matamoros, Valeria; Sibaja-Vargas, Mónica; Varela-Báez, Melisa; Vargas-Forero, Jimena
papers.abstract: Introduction: Microplastics are now pervasive in aquatic ecosystems and represent a growing environmental concern. Their persistence and biological uptake threaten aquatic biodiversity and may affect food webs. In Costa Rica, research on microplastics has mainly focused on coastal and marine systems, leaving freshwater environments less explored. Museum specimens offer a unique opportunity to reconstruct historical patterns of microplastic contamination in these inland waters. Objectives: To examine temporal and spatial variation in microplastic ingestion in Astyanax aeneus, an abundant and widely distributed freshwater fish in Costa Rica. To (1) evaluate long-term changes, (2) compare basins with contrasting levels of human disturbance, and (3) test whether body size influences microplastic ingestion rates. Methods: We analyzed 180 specimens from a national collection spanning seven decades (1960–2025) across three river basins (San Carlos, Tárcoles and Térraba). Gastrointestinal tracts were digested with KOH and examined under stereomicroscopy to identify microplastic particles. Temporal and spatial variations were tested using ANOVAs, and relationships between fish size and microplastic load were assessed with correlation analyses. All procedures included strict contamination control. Results: All specimens contained microplastics, mainly fibers. Microplastic loads increased markedly over time in the San Carlos basin and were substantially higher in the heavily impacted Tárcoles basin. No relationship was detected between fish body size and the number of ingested particles. Conclusions: Freshwater fishes in tropical ecosystems are experiencing increasing microplastic exposure, primarily driven by watershed-level disturbance. The absence of a size-dependent pattern suggests that environmental availability and ecological context play a central role in shaping exposure. Moreover, this study supports the use of museum collections for retrospective monitoring of microplastic pollution and underscores the need for management strategies targeting plastic inputs and wastewater contamination.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用哥斯达黎加国家博物馆收藏的180尾Astyanax aeneus标本（1960–2025年，覆盖三个流域），通过KOH消化和体视显微镜分析，重建了淡水鱼类微塑料摄入的长期变化。结果显示所有个体均含微塑料（以纤维为主），San Carlos流域摄入量随时间显著增加，而人类干扰强烈的Tárcoles流域含量最高；鱼体大小与摄入量无显著相关。研究表明热带淡水鱼类微塑料暴露主要受流域干扰驱动，并证实博物馆标本可用于微塑料污染的回顾性监测，为管理塑料输入和废水污染提供了依据。

papers.title: Scaling up Arctic conservation: why large marine ecosystems should drive ecosystem-based marine conservation
papers.authors: Trubbach, Saskia; Johannesen, Ellen; Sander, Gunnar; Platjouw, Froukje Maria
papers.abstract: In line with international biodiversity commitments, the Arctic Council has called for the establishment of a pan-Arctic marine conservation network, which must be integrated into ecosystem-based management (EBM) to effectively address cumulative pressures and balance conservation and sustainable use. This perspective argues that EBM and marine conservation risk advancing as isolated approaches, and that stronger integration between can be achieved through convergence at a shared, ecologically meaningful spatial scale. Large Marine Ecosystems (LMEs) provide a suitable level due to their ecological relevance and recognition in Arctic Council strategies. Their mostly transboundary nature creates a need for coordinated action among Arctic states. Focusing on scientific assessments and the planning of management measures, the article argues that the application and coordination at LME-level remains inconsistent, resulting in governance approaches that are largely nationally bounded and insufficient to ensure the ecological coherence required for an effective conservation network. We therefore argue that stronger political leadership is needed to align assessments at the level of LMEs and to enhance transboundary coordination in the planning of measures and promote legal coherence.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨北极海洋保护网络与生态系统管理（EBM）的整合问题，指出两者当前存在脱节风险。作者主张以大型海洋生态系统（LMEs）作为共同空间尺度，因其生态相关性强且已被北极理事会战略认可，但跨国界特性要求各国协同行动。分析发现，LME层面的科学评估与管理规划协调不足，导致治理多局限于国家边界，难以保障保护网络的生态连贯性。文章呼吁加强政治领导力，统一LME评估标准，促进跨界措施规划与法律协调，以有效应对累积压力并平衡保护与可持续利用。

papers.title: Marine epiphytic diatoms: a review of environmental controls and ecosystem roles
papers.authors: Auciello, Concetta; Ciniglia, Claudia; Iovinella, Manuela; Pozzuoli, Elio; Pennesi, Chiara; Rabaoui, Lotfi J.; De Stefano, Mario
papers.abstract: Epiphytic diatom assemblages constitute a crucial component of coastal microbenthic ecosystems, yet they remain underexplored compared to other microbenthic organisms. This review provides a comprehensive synthesis of current knowledge on the ecological patterns, drivers, and functional significance of epiphytic diatoms colonizing marine macrophytes. Special attention is given to the relationships between diatoms and their hosts, including seagrasses ( Posidonia oceanica , Zostera marina , Z. noltii, Thalassia testudinum , Cymodocea nodosa ) and macroalgae ( Caulerpa taxifolia , Padina sp., Eucheuma denticulatum ), which provide substrates that influence diatom colonization through morphological traits, leaf turnover rates, and biochemical interactions. The distribution and assemblage structure of epiphytic diatoms are modulated by both biotic interactions (e.g., grazing, competition, host characteristics) and abiotic factors (e.g., salinity, nutrient and light availability, and hydrodynamics). Spatial variability in epiphytic assemblages emerges across latitudinal, regional, and microhabitat gradients, whereas temporal variability is driven by seasonal cycles, environmental instability, and host phenology. Dominant genera such as Cocconeis exhibit specific ecological strategies linked to substrate type and environmental conditions. Growth forms (adnate, erect, motile) represent functional adaptations to the structural and physicochemical properties of different host surfaces. The review highlights the functional relevance of epiphytic diatoms not only as primary producers and key trophic resources but also as sensitive bioindicators of environmental status. Changes in assemblage composition can signal variations in nutrient loading, hydrological regimes, and habitat degradation, making epiphytic diatoms a useful tool for biomonitoring and assessment of coastal ecosystems. Despite growing recognition of their ecological importance, studies on epiphytic diatom assemblages remain scarce, particularly concerning functional traits, host specificity, and large-scale biogeographic patterns.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了海洋附生硅藻的生态格局、驱动因素及其功能意义，重点关注其与海草（如Posidonia oceanica、Zostera marina）和大型藻类（如Caulerpa taxifolia）宿主间的互作关系。研究发现，硅藻的分布与群落结构受生物因素（如摄食、竞争）和非生物因素（如盐度、光照、水动力）共同调控，且优势属如Cocconeis表现出与底物类型相关的特定生态策略。附生硅藻不仅是初级生产者和关键营养资源，还可作为环境状况的敏感生物指示物，其群落组成变化能反映营养负荷和水文变化。尽管其生态重要性日益受认可，但关于功能性状、宿主特异性和大尺度生物地理格局的研究仍显不足。

papers.title: Impact of pancreas disease outbreaks in salmon farming on marine survival and growth of Atlantic salmon post-smolts
papers.authors: Madhun, Abdullah Sami; Karlsbakk, Egil Erlingsson; Skaala, Øystein; Barlaup, Bjørn Torgeir; Karlsen, Ørjan; Andersen-Fjeldheim, Per  Tommy; Solberg, Monica F.; Glover, Kevin A.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦鲑鱼养殖中胰腺疾病（pancreas disease）暴发对大西洋鲑（Atlantic salmon）post-smolts阶段海洋存活率与生长性能的影响。通过对比患病与健康群体的野外监测数据，量化疾病导致的存活率下降及生长迟缓程度。结果显示，胰腺疾病显著降低post-smolts的海洋存活率，并抑制其体长与体重增长，提示疾病暴发对养殖鲑鱼资源补充和经济效益构成严重威胁。

papers.title: Osteological, Biological, and Genetic Consequences of Colonization of Fresh Waters by Marine Cottoid Fishes (Cottidae)
papers.authors: Sideleva, Valentina G.; Zhidkov, Zakhar V.; Annenkova, Nataliia V.; Ryumin, Alexander G.; Melentev, Danila A.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Мarine cottoid fishes of the genus Triglopsis colonized large lakes of glacial genesis in Northern Europe and North America. The fourhorn sculpin Triglopsis quadricornis dispersed into post‐glacial European lakes (e.g., Ladoga and Onega) from the Baltic Sea. The Great Lakes are inhabited by a freshwater species, Triglopsis thompsonii . Lacustrine forms of Triglopsis from North American and European lakes are at different stages of evolution, making them a suitable model for testing hypotheses about evolutionary patterns and rates. An integrative analysis of morphological, genetic, and biological adaptations occurring in lacustrine forms of the genus Triglopsis was carried out. The obtained results demonstrate the presence of rapid adaptive changes in morphological features associated with skeletal lightening. The degree of morphological transformation varies from lake to lake, thus gradual morphological changes are observed. The diet of lake forms is dominated by crustaceans, as in marine Triglopsis , but the objects they consume gradually decrease in size. In contrast to morphological differences, populations are characterized by weak genetic differentiation from each other due to recent colonization (10–15 kya). However, genetic evidence of the adaptive nature of speciation processes occurring in the genus Triglopsis , which are not characteristic of Myoxocephalinae in general, was found. Methods for the detection of natural selection revealed an increase in episodic positive selection occurring in the cytb gene in species of the genus Triglopsis (as well as Megalocottus ) that successfully adapted to low water salinity. Thus, the studied species undergo rapid adaptive changes associated with the colonization of a new habitat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以海洋杜父鱼科Triglopsis属为对象，整合形态、遗传与生物学分析，探究其从海洋向淡水湖泊（如北欧及北美冰川湖）定殖后的演化适应过程。结果显示，湖泊种群在骨骼轻量化等形态特征上发生快速适应性变化，且变化程度随湖泊而异，呈渐进式；食性以甲壳类为主，但猎物尺寸逐渐减小。尽管种群间遗传分化弱（因定殖仅10–15千年），但cytb基因检测到 episodic positive selection，提示低盐适应驱动的适应性物种形成信号。研究表明该属鱼类在新栖息地定殖中经历快速适应性演化，为淡水定殖机制提供模型证据。

papers.title: Antibacterial Activity of Essential Oils as Phytotherapeutic Alternatives Against Aeromonas spp. from Ornamental Fish
papers.authors: Seçer, Faik Sertel
papers.abstract: Aeromonas species are among the most important Gram-negative pathogens in aquaculture and represent a One Health concern, as antibiotic-resistant strains circulate at the interface between ornamental fish, the aquatic environment and humans. This study evaluated the in vitro antibacterial activity of four commercial essential oils from tea tree (Melaleuca alternifolia), peppermint (Mentha piperita), rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis) and lavandin (Lavandula hybrida) against sixteen oxytetracycline-resistant Aeromonas hydrophila and A. veronii isolated from moribund ornamental fish. All tested bacteria were resistant to oxytetracycline (MIC 8–16 µg/mL). Minimum inhibitory (MIC) and minimum bactericidal (MBC) concentrations were determined by broth microdilution. All EOs inhibited every isolate, but their bactericidal capacity differed markedly. Rosemary oil showed the lowest MIC and MBC ranks and the most consistent values, followed by tea tree and lavandin; all three were bactericidal. Peppermint oil, despite a low MIC, showed a high MBC and was bacteriostatic. These findings indicate that the EOs of rosemary, tea tree and lavandin are promising in vitro candidates for use against oxytetracycline-resistant Aeromonas in aquaculture, in line with the One Health approach, and warrant further evaluation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对观赏鱼中分离的16株耐土霉素嗜水气单胞菌（Aeromonas hydrophila）和维氏气单胞菌（A. veronii），评估了茶树、薄荷、迷迭香及杂薰衣草四种商业精油的体外抗菌活性。通过微量肉汤稀释法测定最小抑菌浓度（MIC）和最小杀菌浓度（MBC），结果显示所有精油均能抑制全部菌株，但杀菌能力差异显著：迷迭香精油MIC和MBC值最低且最稳定，茶树和杂薰衣草次之且具杀菌作用，薄荷精油虽MIC低但MBC高，仅呈抑菌效果。研究表明迷迭香、茶树和杂薰衣草精油是应对耐土霉素气单胞菌感染的有前景的体外候选药物，符合One Health理念，值得进一步评估。

papers.title: The Role of Toll-like Receptors (TLRs) in Fish Immunity
papers.authors: Ghosh, Surajit; Paul, Ananya; Sadhu, Auroshree; Roy, Triparna; Saha, Nimai Chandra; Hussain, Aabid; Saha, Shubhajit
papers.abstract: The innate system’s recognition of non-self and danger signals is mediated by a limited number of germline-encoded pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) that recognize pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs). Toll-like receptors (TLRs) are single, non-catalytic, membrane-spanning PRRs present in invertebrates and vertebrates. They act by specifically recognizing PAMPs of a variety of microbes and activate signalling cascades to induce innate immunity. A large number of TLRs has been identified in various teleosts and basal vertebrates. The varied evolutionary lineages of aquatic and warm-blooded higher animals result in some unique characteristics in their TLRs. In innate immunity and pathogen recognition, the majority of them share conserved signalling pathways. Comparing the immunology of teleosts, chondrichthyans, agnathans, and warm-blooded vertebrates requires a functional analysis of novel TLRs in teleosts and basal vertebrates. Furthermore, TLRs play important roles in adaptive immunity in addition to innate immunity. This review describes the discovery of TLRs and their role in fish immunity along their signalling pathway and ligand specificity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了Toll样受体（TLRs）在鱼类免疫中的发现、信号通路及配体特异性，重点探讨其作为模式识别受体（PRRs）在识别病原相关分子模式（PAMPs）和启动先天免疫中的核心作用。通过比较硬骨鱼、软骨鱼、无颌类及温血脊椎动物的TLRs进化特征，揭示了鱼类TLRs的独特性及其在先天和适应性免疫中的双重功能。研究为深入理解鱼类免疫机制及开发水产疾病防控策略提供了理论基础。

papers.title:
Whey Protein Concentrate
(WPC)/Fish Oil Concentrate
Nanoemulsion-Based Nanocomposite Films Reinforced with Nano TiO2 in Two Morphologies
papers.authors: Rodríguez Pineda, Lina M.; Ramos Ramos, María R.; Borroni, Virginia; Candal, Roberto J.; Herrera, María L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Nonbiodegradable, petroleum-based food packaging materials have been shown to cause significant environmental harm, particularly to aquatic ecosystems. As a sustainable alternative, nanocomposite films were developed from nanoemulsions stabilized by whey protein concentrate (WPC), incorporating a discontinuous phase rich in omega-3 oils and reinforced with titanium dioxide (TiO2) nanoparticles in two distinct morphologies: spheres and nanotubes. The effects of droplet size in the discontinuous phase and nanoreinforcement geometry on the films’ physical and mechanical properties were investigated. Film structure and nanoparticle distribution were characterized using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive spectroscopy (EDS), and small- and wide-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS/WAXS). WPC demonstrated environmental adaptability in these nanostructured systems, producing films with uniform thickness, water vapor permeability (WVP), water content, and solubility across different formulations. The use of nanoemulsions as the initial system improved film transparency compared to the ones reported in literature for conventional emulsion-based films. Incorporation of TiO2, whether spherical or tubular, significantly enhanced the films’ light-blocking capabilities. Films reinforced with nanotubes exhibited superior mechanical and tensile performance, achieving the highest storage modulus (E′) and Young’s modulus (E) values among all samples. Nanotube reinforcement also led to reduced opacity and proved more effective than spherical nanoparticles in strengthening the matrix. SEM and EDS analyses revealed a more homogeneous distribution of nanotubes throughout the polymer matrix, in contrast to the bottom-surface accumulation observed with spherical particles. This difference in spatial distribution contributed to the enhanced structural integrity and overall performance of the nanotube-reinforced films. The film containing 0.2% TiO2 nanotubes had the best physical properties, highlighting its strong potential as a sustainable alternative to conventional petroleum-based plastics.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了以乳清蛋白浓缩物（WPC）稳定的纳米乳液为基础、添加两种形态（球形和纳米管）纳米TiO₂增强的可降解纳米复合膜，旨在替代石油基食品包装材料以减少水生生态污染。通过SEM、EDS和SAXS/WAXS表征发现，纳米管增强的薄膜在力学性能（储能模量和杨氏模量）上显著优于球形颗粒，且分布更均匀，0.2% TiO₂纳米管添加量下物理性能最优。该薄膜兼具良好透光性和紫外线阻隔能力，可作为传统塑料的可持续替代品。

papers.title: Optimizing rice husk liquid smoke for safe and sustainable seer fish preservation
papers.authors: Manivel, K.; Karthickumar, P.; Rathnakumar, K.; Murali, S.; Manimehalai, N.; Pradeep, R.; Shawmiya, R.
papers.journal: Journal of Food Science and Technology
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在优化稻壳液烟用于鲭鱼（seer fish）保鲜的安全性与可持续性。通过调整液烟制备条件，评估其对鱼类微生物抑制、脂质氧化及感官品质的影响，以替代传统化学防腐剂。结果显示，优化后的液烟处理可显著延长鲭鱼货架期，同时降低有害化合物残留，为水产品绿色保鲜提供可行方案。

papers.title: Biophysical Factors Controlling Spatiotemporal Variability in Fishes' Early Life History Distribution in the Kattegat Ecosystem
papers.authors: Jørgensen, Kris‐Emil Mose; Grønkjær, Peter; Neuheimer, Anna B.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Kattegat Sea acts as a nursery area for several fishes, exhibiting complex ichthyoplankton dynamics influenced by environmental factors and species‐specific traits. We investigated factors influencing spatiotemporal variability in yolk‐sac larvae presence and areal density for three economically and ecologically important fishes: sandeel ( Ammodytes spp.), Atlantic cod ( Gadus morhua ), and common dab ( Limanda limanda ). We used generalized additive models (GAMs) to reveal how species‐specific presence and density patterns varied with space and time for the 2021 year‐classes. Species‐specific patterns can be explained by a combination of biology (spawning time and mode, and egg dispersal characteristics) and physics (physical advection)—but to varying degrees among the species. Dab timing was consistent with that of batch spawners and previously observed spawning time in the Kattegat. Spatial distribution of dab larvae was widespread and consistent with their pelagic egg stage. Although sandeel could not be identified to species, their presence early in the study period was consistent with lesser sandeel ( A. marinus ) spawning time, spawning mode as total spawners and inflow from the Skagerrak. Spatial distribution of sandeel larvae was patchy, consistent with a lower‐dispersal demersal egg stage. Finally, cod showed a peak in probability of occurrence that was inconsistent with their spawning mode as batch spawners. Inflow from the Skagerrak could explain the temporal pattern with peak timing consistent with previously observed spawning time for cod populations in the Skagerrak. It is unclear how much the Kattegat population contributes to the larval cod year‐class here observed. We conclude that the spatiotemporal variations in distribution are driven by an interplay of physical processes (e.g., advection) and species‐specific biological traits (i.e., spawning time and batch vs. total spawners). Evidence of the influence of physical processes affecting the distribution of fish larvae will have implications for spatial management in the area as well as regions beyond the Kattegat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以Kattegat海域为对象，探究三种经济与生态重要鱼类（玉筋鱼、大西洋鳕、黄盖鲽）仔鱼早期生活史分布时空变异的影响因素。利用广义加性模型（GAMs）分析2021年世代仔鱼存在概率与面积密度的时空格局，发现物种特异性分布模式由生物学特征（产卵时间、产卵方式、卵扩散特性）与物理过程（平流输运）共同驱动，但各物种影响程度不同。黄盖鲽分布广泛且与分批产卵及浮性卵阶段一致；玉筋鱼分布斑块状，符合底栖卵低扩散特性；鳕鱼出现概率峰值与Skagerrak流入水团相关，可能反映外来种群贡献。研究表明物理过程与物种生物学特性交互作用主导仔鱼分布，对Kattegat及邻近海域的空间管理具有重要启示。

papers.title: Widespread and frequent feeding by humpback whales in a highly productive Pacific Mexican breeding area
papers.authors: Kane, Ally; Palacios, Daniel Mauricio; Irvine, Ladd; Urbán R., Jorge; Ransome, Nicola Louise; Viloria-Gómora, Lorena; Martínez-Loustalot, Pamela; Fonseca-Ponce, Iliana Araceli; Zavala-Jiménez, Aldo Alfonso; Kaplan, Rachel L
papers.summary_cn: 座头鲸在墨西哥太平洋高生产力繁殖区内广泛且频繁摄食，该研究旨在探究其摄食行为与繁殖地生态的关系。通过观测与数据分析，发现该区域支持大量鲸鱼觅食活动，挑战了传统认为繁殖地主要用于繁殖而非摄食的观点。研究结果对理解座头鲸栖息地利用及海洋生态系统管理具有重要意义。

papers.title: AFSO-JSSP: Artificial Fish Swarm Optimization for Efficient Job Shop Scheduling
papers.authors: Priya Subramanian, Shunmuga; Athi, Muthiah; Pandian, Pitchipoo; Sivaprakasam, Rajakarunakaran
papers.journal: International Journal of Information Engineering and Electronic Business
papers.abstract: Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP) has become one of the key issues in a contemporary manufacturingsystem in which the task is to optimally schedule jobs to the machines to reduce the time and resources used inproduction. Good scheduling is critical in enhancing the productivity and competitiveness of manufacturing industries.In this research, Artificial Fish Swarm Optimization (AFSO) algorithm is used to optimize the JSSP in minimizingmakespan, total work load and maximum work load in machines. The AFSO strategy models the swarm behaviour offishes to search and forage the search space in an efficient manner to prevent its early convergence to local optima. Themodel incorporates a disturbed state in the world to improve the direction in search and the speed of convergence. Theeffectiveness of the suggested AFSO method is compared and tested with the traditional and sophisticated optimizationalgorithms like Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) methods. The experimentalfindings prove that the offered technique provides better results in convergence rate and solution quality. The resultsprove that AFSO is a useful and promising method of solving complex problems in production system scheduling.
papers.summary_cn: 非渔业相关

papers.title: Do Parasite Effects on Fish Body Condition Depend on Host Size and External Temperature? A Meta‐Analytic Approach
papers.authors: Hasegawa, Ryota; Walter, Callum B.; Poulin, Robert
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Evaluating relationships between host body condition indices (BCIs) and parasite infections is a common approach for assessing the negative effects of parasites on host health. Researchers generally calculate BCIs from host body length‐mass relationships and expect negative correlations between BCIs and infection levels; however, empirical results are often highly variable among host–parasite systems. Here, we hypothesize that two overlooked factors—host body size and external temperature– underlie this variability by modulating the metabolic costs associated with infection. Both of these are particularly well‐known factors that strongly influence host and parasite ecology and physiology. We specifically predict that the negative effects of parasites are stronger in smaller hosts due to their higher mass‐specific metabolic rates, requiring costly energetic allocation toward resistance or tolerance. We also predict that higher temperatures exacerbate these effects by increasing metabolic stress and reducing the host's ability to mitigate infection costs. We tested these predictions using 165 fish BCI‐metazoan parasite infection relationships extracted from 51 published studies providing the required data and compiled systematically. Contrary to our initial predictions, our meta‐regression models revealed no significant effects of host size (body mass) or temperature on the BCI‐infection relationship after accounting for other drivers, such as parasite taxa and types of BCI measures used. We discuss potential mechanisms underlying this pattern, including counter‐adaptive strategies employed by fish hosts to maintain body condition even under suboptimal conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过meta分析评估鱼类体况指数（BCI）与寄生虫感染之间的关系，旨在检验宿主大小和外部温度是否调节寄生虫的负面效应。基于51项研究的165个BCI-后生动物寄生虫感染关系数据，结果显示宿主体重和温度对BCI-感染关系无显著影响，与预期假设相反。作者讨论了鱼类可能采取反适应策略以维持体况的潜在机制，提示寄生虫效应受多因素复杂调控。

papers.title: Study on Certain Aspects of Biology, Length-weight Relationship and Condition Factor of Native Fish Species from Upper Brahmaputra River Basin, India
papers.authors: Singh, Moirangthem Kameshwor; Gogoi, Simi; Saikia, Chandopal; Sonowal, Susmita; Saikia, Netranjally; Thakuria, Emon; Singh, Sanabam Sujen
papers.journal: Agricultural Science Digest - A Research Journal
papers.abstract: Background: The present study deals with the morphometric characters, feeding behavior (RLG and Ga.SI), length-weight relationship (LWR), condition factor (K) and reproductive parameters of four native fish species viz. Channa punctata, Channa gachua, Mystus cavasius and Mystus vittatus collected from upper Brahmaputra river basin, Assam. The Brahmaputra river system in northeast India is a global hotspot for aquatic fauna that shelters a rich and diverse gene pool, especially fish. Methods: The detailed morphometric characters and meristic counts of the selected fish species (Total=200, n=50 for each species) were measured carefully. Twenty-six morphometric and seven meristic parameters were studied for each fish specimen. The study also examined feeding biology (relative gut length and gastro-somatic index) as well as key reproductive characters viz. gonadosomatic index, absolute and relative fecundity and ova diameter. Regression analysis between total body length and weight, ovary length and weight of the selected specimens have also been performed during the study. Result: Present study recorded highest total length in M. cavasius (9.00-15.00 cm) and lowest in M. vittatus (5.60-8.10 cm). The RLG was observed highest in M. cavasius (0.631) and lowest in both C. gachua and M. vittatus (0.45). The regression coefficient (b) indicates negative allometric growth in C. punctata (b= 2.453) and M. vittatus (b= 2.849), while isometric growth was observed in C. gachua (b=3.064) and positive allometric growth in M. cavasius (b= 3.563). Moreover, the r-values for LWRs for all investigated fishes were found ≥ 0.88. The mean condition factor ranged from 0.76-1.35 in all the studied fish species reveals the good health status of the fishes. Absolute fecundity was recorded highest in M. vittatus (3234) and lowest in C. gachua (282). Similarly, relative fecundity was found highest in M. vittatus (840) and lowest in C. gachua (22). Mean GSI was recorded in the ranged of 3.25-63.09. Ova diameter was varied from 0.4-1.2 (cm). Regression analysis between total body length-weight and ovary length-weight of the selected species were also performed and observed strong and positive correlation (r value ranged from 0.797-0.891).
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了印度布拉马普特拉河上游流域四种土著鱼类（Channa punctata、C. gachua、Mystus cavasius、M. vittatus）的形态学、食性（RLG和Ga.SI）、体长-体重关系（LWR）、条件因子（K）及繁殖参数。基于200尾样本（每种50尾）的26项形态和7项可数性状测量，结果显示M. cavasius体长最大（9.00-15.00 cm），M. vittatus最小（5.60-8.10 cm）。LWR回归系数表明C. punctata和M. vittatus呈负异速生长（b=2.453和2.849），C. gachua呈等速生长（b=3.064），M. cavasius呈正异速生长（b=3.563），所有r值≥0.88。条件因子均值0.76-1.35指示鱼类健康状况良好；绝对繁殖力最高见于M. vittatus（3234），最低为C. gachua（282），GSI范围为3.25-63.09，卵径0.4-1.2 cm，体长-体重及卵巢长-重回归均呈强正相关（r=0.797-0.891）。

papers.title: Knowledge, Markets and the State The Political Economy and Discursive Construction of India’s Fisheries Sector
papers.authors: Kaushal, Kundan; Upadhyay, Manisha
papers.abstract: The research explores the knowledge existing in the and with the fishing communities of India and how does the state play its part to communicae with their knowledge and establishing its link with the market which also in othe way is the guardian of the both.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨印度渔业社区所拥有的知识体系，以及国家如何与其沟通并建立知识与市场的联系，同时国家也作为两者的守护者。通过政治经济学和话语建构视角，分析知识、市场与国家在印度渔业部门中的互动机制。研究发现，国家在整合地方性知识与市场逻辑中扮演关键角色，但存在知识传递与权力不对等的问题。

papers.title: Occurrence of Microplastics in Commercial Fish Species in Nigeria: A Case Study of Lower Usuma Dam and Jabi Lake, Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, Nigeria
papers.authors: Bulus, Michael; Etsuyankpa, Muhammad Binin; Usman, Abdullahi
papers.abstract: The emergence of microplastics pollution poses a significant environmental and health concern on freshwater ecosystems as well as human health, due to its persistence and potential ecological impacts. Microplastics contamination remains greatly under reported across the Nigerian aquatic ecosystem and as such, only limited data exist for the occurrence of microplastics in the region. This present study was carried to investigate for the first time, the occurrence of microplastics in Lower Usuma Dam and Jabi Lake in the Federal Capital Territory of Nigeria. The gastrointestinal tract of common commercial fish species in the locations Lates niloticus (Nile Perch) and Oreochromis niloticus (Nile Tilapia) were analyzed, and microplastics were found in 60% and 80% of each fish species collected from the two sampling locations. Similarly, a total of 71 microplastics particles were also recovered from water samples collected from the two locations confirming the prevalence of microplastics. Polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), and polystyrene (PS) were found in the surface water samples while Nylon (N), polyethylene terepthtalate (PET) were predominant in fishes collected. Generally, the shape distribution of microplastics particles were reported in the order fragment>foam>filament>film. Statistical analysis carried out showed no significant relationship between microplastics ingestion in different fish species and microplastics in the selected water bodies (P > 0.05). These findings highlight the need for further research in the region in other to identify and assess the full extent of microplastics pollution and how it affects the aquatic life as well as human health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次调查了尼日利亚联邦首都特区Lower Usuma Dam和Jabi Lake中商业鱼类（尼罗河鲈鱼Lates niloticus和尼罗罗非鱼Oreochromis niloticus）的微塑料污染状况。通过分析鱼类胃肠道及水样，发现60%和80%的鱼类个体分别检出微塑料，水样中共回收71个微塑料颗粒，证实该区域微塑料普遍存在。表面水样中主要检出聚乙烯（PE）、聚丙烯（PP）和聚苯乙烯（PS），而鱼类体内以尼龙（N）和聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）为主，颗粒形态分布为碎片>泡沫>纤维>薄膜。统计分析显示鱼类微塑料摄入与水体微塑料含量无显著相关性（P > 0.05），提示需进一步研究微塑料污染对水生生态和人类健康的潜在影响。

papers.title: Fish cell lines in aquaculture and biomedical research: A global perspective on development, repositories, and multidisciplinary applications
papers.authors: Kumar, Anand; Vimal, Bhartendu; Kumar, Vikash; Sarker, Sudeshna; Kumari, Pushpa; Paul, Tapas; Rout, Ajaya Kumar; Saini, Ved Prakash; Pandey, Pramod Kumar; Behera, Bijay Kumar
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了鱼类细胞系在水产养殖与生物医学研究中的全球发展现状，涵盖其建立、资源库及多学科应用。重点讨论了鱼类细胞系在病毒学、毒理学、免疫学及疾病防控中的关键作用，并展望了其在精准养殖和人类疾病模型中的潜力。研究强调建立标准化细胞库和共享机制对推动该领域发展的重要性。

papers.title:
Spatiotemporal Prediction
of River Fish Biodiversity
by Multimodal Deep Learning of eDNA and Satellite Imagery
papers.authors: Zhang, Song; Zhang, Xiaowei; Zhong, Wenjun; Wang, Yifan; Zong, Shuo; Pellissier, Loïc
papers.abstract: Abstract High-resolution spatiotemporal biodiversity maps are essential for conservation and environmental management of freshwater ecosystems. Yet existing eDNA-based approaches remain largely static and spatially extrapolative, discarding fine-grained landscape structure and overlooking interannual dynamics. Here, we developed a multimodal deep learning framework that integrates raw satellite imagery with environmental tabular covariates to predict fish species richness across river networks, using eDNA-derived richness from 1302 sites across six Chinese river basins as training labels. The framework couples a U-Net encoder–decoder with a novel water-guided spatial attention mechanism that leverages MNDWI-derived water masks to prioritize aquatic and riparian pixels, and an attention autoencoder that compresses high-dimensional environmental variables into a latent representation. Ablation experiments confirmed that multimodal fusion of imagery and tabular data substantially outperformed single-modality baselines (R2 from 0.54 to 0.76), and that the water-guided attention mechanism yielded further gains (R2 = 0.81), demonstrating that raw imagery preserves ecologically critical spatial information lost by conventional buffer-based summarization. The model was validated on fully independent basins (middle Yangtze and Yuan River) and multiyear field surveys (2018–2023). It achieved strong spatial transferability (r = 0.83 and 0.69) without region-specific retraining, and captured interannual recovery trends following the Yangtze fishing ban without any direct policy input. By shifting from static spatial extrapolation to prediction that generalizes across space and time, this framework offers a scalable pathway for freshwater biodiversity monitoring and conservation evaluation under the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了一种多模态深度学习框架，整合卫星影像与环境表格数据预测河流鱼类物种丰富度，以中国六个流域1302个位点的eDNA数据为训练标签。该框架结合U-Net编码器-解码器与水引导空间注意力机制（利用MNDWI水掩膜优先处理水生和河岸像素），并通过注意力自编码器压缩高维环境变量。消融实验表明，多模态融合显著优于单模态基线（R²从0.54提升至0.76），水引导注意力机制进一步优化至R²=0.81；在独立流域（长江中游和沅江）及多年野外调查（2018–2023）中验证了强空间迁移性（r=0.83和0.69），并能捕捉长江禁渔后的年际恢复趋势。该框架从静态空间外推转向时空泛化预测，为淡水生物多样性监测和保护评估提供了可扩展路径。

papers.title: The importance of riverine islands: scaling and linking hydro-morphological and fish diversity in a very large river
papers.authors: Erős, T.; Feng, Kai; Tóth, B.; Sevcsik, A.; Szalóky, Z.
papers.abstract: Riverine islands are keystone geomorphic features that enhance hydro-morphological heterogeneity in large rivers; how island-associated main and side channels contribute to the taxonomic and functional diversity of fish assemblages in regulated rivers, however, remains poorly understood. Therefore, we applied a hierarchical spatial framework to examine how hydro-morphological variation between main and side channels would structure fish assemblages along three islands in the Middle Danube (Hungary). Principal component analyses of physical habitat variables revealed that main channel habitats were characterized by higher velocities and coarser substrates, whereas side channels exhibited slower flow, finer sediments, and greater macrophyte and herbaceous cover. Overall, habitat-type effects in physical structure were stronger and more consistent than regional differences among islands. Shoreline electrofishing revealed pronounced differences in fish assemblages associated with hydro-morphological variation. Specifically, rarefaction analyses justified higher species richness in side channels and complementarity between habitat types, indicating that each harbored some unique species that contributed to gamma diversity. Multivariate analyses demonstrated clear separation in the taxonomic structure of fish assemblages between main and side channels. Functional analyses mirrored taxonomic patterns, showing distinct trait compositions along hydro-morphological gradients. Velocity and substrate composition emerged as the key environmental drivers that structure both taxonomic and functional structure, thus highlighting the importance of hydro-morphological heterogeneity. Our findings identify riverine islands and their side channels as biodiversity amplifiers that sustain lateral habitat complexity and increase hydro-morphological, taxonomic, and functional diversity in regulated large rivers. Protecting and restoring island–side-channel complexes should therefore be prioritized in process-based river restoration strategies, such as the EU Nature Restoration Regulation, to counteract habitat homogenization and enhance lateral connectivity and functional resilience.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了大型河流中河心岛对水文地貌异质性和鱼类多样性的促进作用，聚焦于多瑙河中游三个岛屿的主河道与侧河道生境差异。通过主成分分析和河岸电渔采样，发现侧河道具有更细的底质、更缓的水流及更高的水生植被覆盖，且鱼类物种丰富度和功能多样性显著高于主河道，两者互补贡献了γ多样性。流速和底质组成是驱动鱼类分类和功能结构的关键环境因子，表明河心岛及其侧河道是调节性河流中维持横向连通性和生物多样性的核心地貌特征。研究建议在欧盟自然恢复法规等基于过程的河流修复策略中，优先保护和恢复岛屿-侧河道复合体，以缓解生境均质化并增强生态功能韧性。

papers.title: Improving Fish Production and Nutrition in South Sudan: A Pathway to Food Security and Sustainable Development
papers.authors: Alosias, John; Garang, Albino
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology
papers.abstract: This study explored the status and potential of South Sudan’s rich fisheries resources to enhance food security and sustainable development through improved fish production and nutrition. Despite the abundant aquatic resources in South Sudan, the fisheries sector remains underdeveloped and characterized by artisanal practices, limited infrastructure and policy gaps that restrict productivity as well as accessibility. Fish plays a critical role in household nutrition by providing high-quality protein, essential micronutrients and omega-3 fatty acids that all have the potential to alleviate malnutrition and food insecurity. But challenges such as political and fishing conflicts, climate variability, poor market access and cultural barriers hinder the growth of the fisheries sector in South Sudan. This desk review research, therefore, synthesized secondary data to assess the current status, challenges and opportunities in the fisheries sector in South Sudan. As a result, the importance of multifaceted interventions including aquaculture development, modernization of fishing practices, infrastructure investment, policy reform, and nutrition education were highlighted and emphasized. Upgrading production and postharvest related activities is considered a pathway towards improving nutrition, economic empowerment and resilience for vulnerable communities in South Sudan. Furthermore, the study appealed for integrated approaches and further research investigations to realize the full potential of the fisheries sector in contributing to national food security and sustainable development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过综述二手数据，评估了南苏丹渔业资源现状、挑战与机遇，旨在提升鱼类生产和营养以促进粮食安全与可持续发展。研究发现，尽管水产资源丰富，但渔业受制于手工捕捞、基础设施不足和政策缺口，且面临政治冲突、气候多变及市场准入障碍。文章强调，多层面干预措施（如 aquaculture development、捕捞现代化、基础设施投资、政策改革和营养教育）是改善脆弱社区营养、经济赋权和韧性的关键路径，并呼吁综合策略与进一步研究以释放渔业部门潜力。

papers.title: Nitrogen Metabolism and Pathogen Feedback in Intensive Aquaculture: Reframing Ammonia Nitrogen as a Reactive Node
papers.authors: Yu, Junfei; Yang, Hongling; Cai, Guohe; Xia, Banghua; Sun, Yunzhang
papers.abstract: Feeds rich in protein are the dominant nitrogen input in intensive aquaculture, yet only part of dietary nitrogen is retained as animal biomass; the remainder enters water and sediment through uneaten feed, feces, dissolved wastes, mucus, sloughed tissue, and branchial ammonia excretion. This review aims to integrate nutritional, physiological, microbial, and disease-related evidence into an evidence-graded framework that positions ammonia nitrogen as a reactive node linking feed, host, water, sediment, and pathogen risk. To assemble this evidence, we conducted a structured narrative search of Web of Science and PubMed for records in English or Chinese published from 2006 to July 2026, with no restriction on publication type, and classified evidence as direct, indirect, or conceptual. The strongest evidence shows that dietary protein supply, amino acid balance, digestibility, and feeding regime regulate nitrogen retention and ammonia output, while microbial ammonification, nitrification, denitrification, dissimilatory nitrate reduction to ammonium, anammox, and assimilation determine whether reactive nitrogen is regenerated, retained, or removed. Experimental studies further show that ammonia impairs oxidative balance, mucosal barriers, immunity, and disease resistance. In contrast, evidence that pathogen infection quantitatively alters nitrogen retention, ammonia excretion, organic nitrogen release, and sedimentary ammonium regeneration remains limited and largely indirect. Accordingly, ammonia nitrogen is framed as a measurable reactive node rather than a unique source or a universally validated causal loop. Practical management should combine precision nutrition with water, biofloc, sediment, and disease surveillance, while future factorial studies and isotope tracer studies should quantify the complete nitrogen budget under pathogen challenge.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述整合营养学、生理学、微生物学及病害学证据，提出将氨氮视为集约化养殖中连接饲料、宿主、水体、沉积物和病原风险的“反应节点”。基于2006至2026年间Web of Science和PubMed的结构化检索，证据分级显示：饲料蛋白供应、氨基酸平衡及投喂策略调控氮保留与氨输出，而微生物氨化、硝化及反硝化等过程决定活性氮的去向；实验证实氨氮损害氧化平衡、黏膜屏障和免疫抗病力，但病原感染对氮收支的定量影响证据有限且多为间接。建议将精准营养与水质、生物絮团、沉积物及病害监测相结合，并采用因子设计和同位素示踪量化病原胁迫下的完整氮预算。

papers.title: Ontogenetic shifts in salinity tolerance and metabolic strategies of Heliocidaris crassispina: implications for aquaculture management
papers.authors: Li, Zirui; Sun, Qiyang; Su, Dejian; Ming, Yang; Wen, Junyi; Yu, Zonghe
papers.summary_cn: 标题研究海胆（Heliocidaris crassispina）的盐度耐受性与代谢策略随个体发育的变化，旨在为养殖管理提供依据。研究发现其盐度适应能力和代谢模式随生长阶段显著改变，提示养殖需分阶段调控盐度条件。该结果对优化海胆人工育苗及成体养殖的水环境管理具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Understanding women’s participation in northeastern oyster aquaculture
papers.authors: Lord, Natalie; Ashcraft, Catherine; Novak-Colwell, Julia; Williams, Lindsey; White, Easton R.
papers.abstract: The increasing participation of women aquaculture producers brings diverse perspectives and innovative solutions to the industry in the Northeastern United States. However, without baseline demographic data of the workforce, we lack comprehensive understanding of resource management, distribution of benefits, and equitable access to the seafood system. A mixed methods approach including a survey and the participatory research method, photovoice, was implemented to characterize demographics and understand gender dynamics of the Maine and New Hampshire oyster aquaculture industry. A gender analysis was conducted to investigate how women access resources and navigate barriers to participation as oyster producers. The food systems concept was used to investigate a gender division of labor in the oyster aquaculture industry. Results indicate that established gender norms create systemic barriers for women-owned oyster businesses including gender discrimination and insufficient access to funding, targeted training, and farm equipment. Women leveraged female-led social networks to learn about growing methods that addressed affordability, occupational safety, and production efficiency on their farms. To maintain autonomy over decision making and avoid gendered outcomes, women participate in all activities of the food system, from oyster production to market sales, indicating no gender division of labor. This paper argues that women oyster farmers experience gender-specific obstacles due to cultural norms of the maritime industry that have traditionally supported only men. More work is required to build data informed policy mechanisms and institutional support systems that ensure equitable participation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查美国东北部女性参与牡蛎养殖的现状，采用混合方法（问卷调查与photovoice参与式研究）分析缅因州和新罕布什尔州牡蛎养殖业的性别动态。研究发现，传统性别规范为女性养殖户带来系统性障碍，包括性别歧视及资金、培训和设备获取不足；女性通过女性主导的社会网络学习养殖技术，并参与从生产到销售的全链条活动以保持决策自主权。论文指出，海洋产业文化传统上偏向男性，需建立数据驱动的政策机制和制度支持以确保公平参与。

papers.title: Wild-harvesting of the fucoid Fucus vesiculosus (Phaeophyceae) at an active oyster aquaculture site
papers.authors: Cunningham, Eoghan Mánus; Maggs, Christine A.; Walsh, Pamela J.
papers.abstract: Macroalgae are seen as a sustainable resource for industries including agriculture, food, and nutraceuticals. Aquaculture is the dominant form of global seaweed biomass production, yet wild-harvesting remains important in Europe. Fucoid species such as Fucus vesiculosus commonly colonise intertidal shores and artificial structures, including oyster farms in Ireland, where they represent a largely unexploited biomass resource. However, the amount of biomass produced annually on oyster farms is unknown, making it unclear whether this resource could be harvested sustainably and potentially provide a new opportunity for shellfish farmers. Hence, this study investigated the potential for sustainable harvesting by management of F. vesiculosus fouling on an oyster aquaculture site, quantifying post-harvest seaweed biomass yield and regeneration. F. vesiculosus thalli were harvested under three treatments, a control (no cut), a longer cut to ~6 cm (Cut L) and a shorter cut to ~3.5 cm (Cut S) and regrowth was quantified over a 12-month period from April 2025 to 2026. The harvested F. vesiculosus thalli regenerated up to 87% of pre-harvest lengths within 12 months. The thalli showed non-linear seasonal growth patterns, with thallus lengths increasing over time. The Cut S treatment resulted in a higher relative growth rate among treatments and a greater initial biomass yield of 0.54 kg per m of trestle. Having determined the total number of oyster trestles in a 1 km stretch of shoreline, we estimated that ~11 tonnes of biomass could be harvested using the Cut S treatment. Our results suggest that low intensity partial harvesting of settled F. vesiculosus on oyster farms could be sustainable, and our results provide proof-of-concept for future co-location of Fucus crops and oysters within a shellfish aquaculture site.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了在爱尔兰牡蛎养殖场主动采收野生墨角藻（Fucus vesiculosus）的可持续性，旨在量化其生物量产量与再生能力。通过设置对照、长切（~6 cm）和短切（~3.5 cm）三种处理，在12个月内监测再生情况，发现藻体可恢复至采收前长度的87%，且短切处理相对生长率最高，初始生物量达0.54 kg/m养殖架。基于1 km海岸线的牡蛎架总数，估算短切处理可收获约11吨生物量。结果表明，低强度部分采收养殖区附生墨角藻具有可持续性，为未来贝藻共养提供了概念验证。

papers.title: Amino Acids in the Natural Food Web of Global Fishponds: Way Forward for Precision Protein Feeding in Pond Cyprinid Aquaculture
papers.authors: Hossain, Md. Foysul; Sezimova, Katerina; Mraz, Jan; Gebauer, Radek; Zabransky, Lubos; Roy, Koushik
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Natural food webs in freshwater pond ecosystems provide an important nutritional foundation for cyprinid aquaculture, yet information on their protein and amino acid composition remains fragmented. This review synthesized published data from 30 studies (1950–2026) reporting protein and indispensable amino acid (IAA) composition of freshwater natural food resources, including algae, zooplankton, and zoobenthos. Protein and IAA concentrations were standardized on a dry matter basis and evaluated relative to common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ) amino acid requirement benchmarks. Natural food protein quantity and quality followed the trophic pattern zooplankton > zoobenthos > algae. The IAA profiles in zooplankton and zoobenthos mostly met or exceeded common carp dietary benchmarks, unlike algae which may fall short. Relative trophic position (RTP) was positively associated with all IAAs, supporting the concept of trophic upgrading within freshwater food webs. Lysine exhibited the strongest relationship with RTP ( R 2 = 0.551), demonstrating a high sensitivity to natural food choices by pond carp, whereas methionine showed the weakest relationship, strictly controlled across trophic levels, making it one of the most difficult IAAs to source in pond food web. Our analysis suggests that any ideal protein concept for supplementary feed for ponds should be centered around methionine (as denominator), as most supplementary pond feed protein ingredients may exacerbate the methionine deficiencies and undermine protein utilization. A nutritional ecology framework integrating food web IAA into precision pond feed, with complementary ingredient choices, can greatly enhance the efficiency and cleanliness of pond aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了1950–2026年间30项研究，分析了全球鱼塘自然食物网（藻类、浮游动物、底栖动物）的蛋白质和必需氨基酸（IAA）组成，并以鲤鱼氨基酸需求为基准进行评价。结果显示，自然食物蛋白质数量和质量呈浮游动物>底栖动物>藻类的营养级模式，浮游动物和底栖动物的IAA谱基本满足或超过鲤鱼需求，而藻类可能不足。赖氨酸与相对营养级位置（RTP）关联最强（R²=0.551），蛋氨酸关联最弱且在各营养级严格受控，成为鱼塘食物网中最难获取的IAA。据此建议，池塘补充饲料的理想蛋白概念应以蛋氨酸为分母，因多数补充蛋白源可能加剧蛋氨酸缺乏，整合食物网IAA的营养生态学框架可提升精准投喂效率和养殖清洁度。

papers.title: California salmon returns track deteriorating freshwater and marine conditions
papers.authors: Munsch, Stuart H.; Greene, Correigh; Satterthwaite, William H
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Climate change and human activities are pushing aquatic ecosystems into novel states; therefore, it is crucial to understand how ecosystem conditions affect fish. We quantified relationships between ecological conditions and recruitment for three California Chinook salmon stocks. Using linear and generalized additive models across rolling time windows, we identified indicators of freshwater and marine conditions that were persistently or recently important to recruitment (i.e., adult returns). We found that recruitment was higher following years with abundant natural area spawners, high outmigration flows, cool outmigration and incubation temperatures, low marine predator buffering, and positive NPGO phases. Inspection of these indicators across time revealed that ecosystem conditions have deteriorated over the past two decades, characterized by rising watershed temperatures, droughts, pulses of low marine predator buffering, and negative NPGO phases. Our results bolster prior research suggesting California’s salmon production system of worsening climate conditions and degraded habitats exemplifies a shifted ecological baseline. Ultimately, our work contributes to understanding why California’s salmon have performed poorly recently and an ecosystem perspective that informs decisions and expectations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究量化了加州三种奇努克鲑（Chinook salmon）种群的生态条件与补充量（成鱼回归）之间的关系，采用线性模型和广义加性模型在滚动时间窗口内识别关键淡水与海洋环境指标。结果显示，高补充量出现在自然产卵区丰富、出流流量大、孵化和迁徙温度较低、海洋捕食缓冲低及NPGO正相位年份。过去二十年生态系统条件持续恶化，表现为流域升温、干旱、低捕食缓冲脉冲和负NPGO相位，印证了加州鲑鱼生产系统面临气候恶化与栖息地退化的生态基线偏移，为近期鲑鱼表现不佳提供了机制解释。

papers.title: Functional probiotic attributes of Bacillus subtilis ULB16, an endophyte isolated from marine macroalga, Ulva lactuca
papers.authors: Anand, Swathy Sadanandan; Hely, Sreetha; Nair, Bipin Gopalakrishnan; Nair, Sudarslal Sadasivan; Prakash, Vidhya; Pai, Jayashree Gopalakrishna
papers.abstract: Marine-derived probiotic bacteria have emerged as promising alternatives to antibiotics in sustainable aquaculture owing to their resilience, metabolic versatility, and ability to produce beneficial bioactive compounds. In the present study, the probiotic and functional potential of Bacilllus subtilis ULB16, a marine endophytic bacterium isolated from Ulva lactuca , was comprehensively evaluated. The safety assessment revealed susceptibility to several clinically relevant antibiotics, while no extracellular DNase activity was detected, supporting its non-virulent nature. The strain exhibited tolerance to gastrointestinal-like stress conditions, including acidic pH, bile salts, and simulated gastric juice, indicating its ability to survive gastrointestinal transit. Functional probiotic characterization demonstrated cell surface hydrophobicity, auto-aggregation, and co-aggregation with representative enteric pathogens ( Escherichia coli , Salmonella enterica , and Klebsiella pneumoniae ) as well as aquaculture-associated pathogens ( Aeromonas hydrophila and Vibrio parahaemolyticus ). B. subtilis ULB16 also exhibited biofilm-forming ability and showed higher adhesion to HT-29 intestinal epithelial cells than the commercial probiotic strain Alkalihalobacillus clausii. Notably, the isolate exhibited β-galactosidase activity of 0.0565 U/mL, a relatively uncommon feature among Bacillus -based probiotics, suggesting additional nutritional and functional benefits associated with lactose metabolism. Collectively, the findings demonstrate that B. subtilis ULB16 possesses a combination of desirable probiotic traits, including stress tolerance, pathogen interaction capability, epithelial adhesion, and functional enzyme activity. These multifunctional properties highlight its potential as a promising marine-derived probiotic candidate for sustainable biotechnological applications.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究从海洋大型藻类石莼（Ulva lactuca）中分离出内生菌Bacillus subtilis ULB16，并全面评估其益生潜力。该菌株对临床相关抗生素敏感、无DNase活性，且耐受酸性pH、胆盐及模拟胃液等胃肠道胁迫条件。功能表征显示其具备细胞表面疏水性、自聚集及与肠道病原菌（大肠杆菌、肠炎沙门氏菌、肺炎克雷伯菌）和水产病原菌（嗜水气单胞菌、副溶血弧菌）的共聚集能力，同时表现出生物膜形成及对HT-29肠上皮细胞的强黏附性。值得注意的是，该菌株具有β-半乳糖苷酶活性（0.0565 U/mL），这在Bacillus益生菌中较为罕见，提示其额外的乳糖代谢营养功能，可作为可持续水产养殖中具有应用前景的海洋源益生菌候选菌株。

papers.title: Sustainable Integrated Multi‐Trophic Aquaculture: Key Considerations for Assessing Environmental and Economic Performance
papers.authors: Hornborg, Sara; Capoccioni, Fabrizio; Irz, Xavier; Langeland, Markus; Martini, Arianna; Pulcini, Domitilla; Salenius, Fredrik; Ziegler, Friederike
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Integrated multi‐trophic aquaculture (IMTA), defined as the co‐production of species at different trophic levels, is conceptually appealing. By utilising complementary functions of different species, it holds opportunities for lower environmental impact, higher productivity, and increased profitability in comparison with conventional monoculture. However, whether those advantages materialise in practice remains unclear. Here we review available life cycle assessment (LCA) and cost–benefit analysis (CBA) studies of IMTAs to further the current understanding of environmental and economic performance. We find that, overall, LCAs conclude that IMTAs investigated have not been able to deliver on environmental promises, while CBAs generally find that IMTAs have both better financial performance and lower environmental externalities than monoculture equivalents. The main reasons for these contrasting findings include the nature of the systems assessed so far—often theoretical or experimental set‐ups with non‐optimised designs—combined with methodological choices in assessments. The findings of the review thus suggest that it is still unclear to what extent IMTA can deliver on its promises in practice, and that IMTA is no panacea for aquaculture but requires careful design to be effective for its intended use. Integrating robust LCAs and CBAs early in the development phase can help identify viable IMTA set‐ups based on key drivers of environmental and economic performance and, in this way, minimise the risks of misaligned practices. A first step towards realising the potential of IMTA is to carry out robust assessments that avoid key mistakes in both LCAs and CBAs, to which end we provide hands‐on recommendations for future assessments.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了综合多营养级水产养殖（IMTA）的环境与经济绩效评估研究，通过分析生命周期评估（LCA）和成本效益分析（CBA）文献发现，LCA显示IMTA未显著降低环境影响，而CBA则表明其财务表现和外部性优于单养。研究指出，评估结果差异源于系统设计非优化和方法选择，强调IMTA并非万能，需早期整合LCA和CBA以识别可行方案，并为未来评估提供实践建议。
